class.name: Texture3DRD
class.brief_description: Texture for 3D that is bound to a texture created on the [RenderingDevice].
class.description: This texture class allows you to use a 3D texture created directly on the [RenderingDevice] as a texture for materials, meshes, etc. [b]Note:[/b] [Texture3DRD] is intended for low-level usage with [RenderingDevice]. For most use cases, use [Texture3D] instead. [b]Note:[/b] On the web (WebGPU), whose texture views cannot swizzle, a [RenderingDevice] texture in [constant RenderingDevice.DATA_FORMAT_R8_UNORM] or [constant RenderingDevice.DATA_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM] format is described as [constant Image.FORMAT_R8] or [constant Image.FORMAT_RG8] and is drawn as such (red, or red and green, with an alpha of 1). On other platforms it is described as [constant Image.FORMAT_L8] or [constant Image.FORMAT_LA8] and drawn as grayscale (with green as alpha). To get the same result everywhere, use a [constant RenderingDevice.DATA_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM] texture, or read the channel you need in the shader.

members.member: The RID of the texture object created on the [RenderingDevice].
